Name: Small Boots For All - Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿

[center]This is an updated version of my mod These Boots Are Made For Hiding, and now includes a version for both body types! ^-^
I did my best to match up the animations, but if you notice anything that looks weird, please let me know any info about it.
There are some differences between the short and tall versions, since when I tested them the same boot sprite didn't always look right on both heights.

As always, the boots are colorable!
(Also, the flower crown shown in the images will be uploaded later today!)




[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]﻿
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿!
Unzip the file and drop the folder, [FS] Luny's Small Boots, into your StardewValley/mods folder.
It'll now appear in the Fashion Sense menu.[/center]
